title: Finite lisse partition structure
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $F$ a set-valued sheaf on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and $T$ a subset of its underlying space. A finite lisse partition of $T$ consists of a natural number $n$, schemes $S_i$ and immersions $g_i:S_i\to X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion], indexed by $i<n$, whose images are pairwise disjoint and have union $T$, such that the set inverse image of $F$ along every $g_i$ is finite locally constant, with finite geometric stalks [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Empty parts and $n=0$ are permitted.
